title: Οι Συλλογές Μελιών | Aesthlos
description: Our honey collection comes from families of beekeepers with a tradition of at least half a century in beekeeping, using entirely natural and organic methods. The transportation of bees to various regions across Greece allows the collection of honey from different nectars and blossoms, creating a natural pharmacy that protects the human body and fortifies its health.
